Tools.Floor: Paint floor hints (click or drag; right-click erases)
Tools.Wall: Paint wall hints (click or drag; right-click erases)

watch.Name: Patrols keep watch
watch.Hint: Patrolling NPCs notice player characters in their field of view (with line of sight through walls) and react.

alertSeconds.Name: Stay alert for (seconds)
alertSeconds.Hint: How long an NPC stays alert after losing sight of an intruder, before walking back to its route.

chaseSpeed.Name: Chase speed
chaseSpeed.Hint: How much faster than their patrol pace NPCs move when chasing.

alarmRadius.Name: Alarm radius (squares)
alarmRadius.Hint: Patrols this close to one that raises the alarm come to investigate.

whisper.Name: Whisper sightings to the GM
whisper.Hint: A private chat message when a patrol spots someone.

pauseOnSpot.Name: Pause the game on a sighting
pauseOnSpot.Hint: Pause the game whenever a patrol spots a player character.

pauseInCombat.Name: Patrols stop in combat
pauseInCombat.Hint: When combat starts patrols stop; when it ends they walk back to their routes and carry on.

Info.Scanned: Scan done: {floor}% floor, {walls} new walls proposed, {rooms} rooms.

Warn.NoNPCs: No NPCs to patrol with these settings.
Warn.SelectTokens: Select one or more tokens first.
Warn.NoWayBack: {name} can't find a way back to its route (a door closed behind it?). It waits where it is and tries again every few seconds.

Error.NoHub: Kostis's Auto-Patrol System needs the Kostis's Flying Paths module. Enable it in Manage Modules.
Error.NoAnimator: Kostis's Auto-Patrol System moves NPCs with Kostis's Actual Animator. Enable it in Manage Modules.
Error.Tainted: The map image can't be read (it is served from another website). Upload it to your Foundry data folder and try again.
